Week-one item **A** of #221. The spine — everything else in the initiative depends on it. **No dependencies; start here.**

Rulings this implements: ADR-0061 Decisions 1, 2, 5; #221's secrets and sequencing rulings.

## What

`just dispatch` — one recipe, parameterised by lane, that starts a logical subagent as a **separate process** and returns without waiting.

- **Lane** selects the runner and its environment. Week one has two, both on the `claude` binary: `claude-native` (a dispatched `claude -p`, which is a main session and so carries the one-hour cache TTL) and `zai` (#221 item D).
- **Profile** is the unit, per ADR-0061 Decision 5: `(lane, model, effort)` as one opaque token — `opus-high`, `zai-glm52-max`. A registry maps profile to the flags that realise it (`--model`, `--effort`, and for the z.ai lane the base URL and `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL`).
- **Environment** assembled per invocation and never globally. `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` set globally would silently redirect every Claude Code session on this box, the orchestrator included. Credentials from `~/.arma-cti/credentials.env` at mode 0600, by environment, never on argv.
- **Identity** via `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`: `cti.dispatch_id`, `cti.lane`, `cti.profile`, `cti.seat`, `cti.issue`, `cti.base_sha`. This is what makes every record self-identifying downstream.
- **Worktree** created and asserted. Per #105's fourth instance, the dispatched process must verify `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` matches its assignment and refuse loudly if it does not, rather than silently working elsewhere.
- **Detached**, returning at once with a dispatch id, per CLAUDE.md's rule that a turn does not block for five minutes.

Logic in Python under pytest; bash only at the seams it owns (process launch, environment assembly, signals), per ADR-0049.

## Not in scope

The MCP tool façade. Week one is two `claude`-binary lanes and a recipe; the façade becomes real when a foreign harness arrives. Recorded on #221.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `just dispatch --lane claude-native --profile opus-high --seat implementer --issue N` starts a detached run and returns a dispatch id
- [ ] Environment is per invocation; a test asserts no `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` leaks into the parent or a sibling lane
- [ ] The dispatched process refuses and reports if its worktree is not the one assigned
- [ ] `cti.*` resource attributes appear on that run's OTel records
- [ ] Credentials never appear in `ps` output or in any committed file; gitleaks added to `just check`
- [ ] `just check`, `just unit` green; the command table row lands with the recipe, or follows through the sign-off gate

Refs #221, #195, #105
